sloka: ममन्थ च महाकायो राक्षसान् वानरेश्वरः।युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव ।। ६.९७.१० ।।
transliteration: mamantha ca mahākāyo rākṣasān vānareśvaraḥ।yugāntasamaye vāyuḥ pravṛddhānagamāniva ।। 6.97.10 ।।

translations.english: The Vanara Lord of gigantic body, moving like the wind, tortuously destroyed the Rakshasas like a huge wind destroying the universe.
